title: a thin beam that opens on the bongo
story: The guitar requinto opens alone: one thin beam, its tone stepping with each requinto note, dim and still. At the 164 hit (20.9, bright) the beam opens to full intensity and the bongo martillo starts: every bright stroke swells the beam's amplitude, every dark open tone snaps the beam to a square edge and lifts the brightness. The beam flips every half bar between a soft focus and a sharper one, mint then aqua, so the room keeps the bar.
